places.name: Matterhorn Glacier Paradise (Klein Matterhorn)
places.ai_summary: The highest cable car station in Europe, offering year-round skiing, snowboarding, and stunning views of the Matterhorn.
places.place_tip: Dress warmly, even in summer, as it can be cold at the top.

attribution.title: Aletschgletscher-Eggishorn
attribution.author: Tobias Alt, Tobi 87
attribution.credit: Own work
attribution.description: The largest and longest glacier of the Alps: the Aletsch Glacier seen from Eggishorn, Valais, Switzerland. Mountain panorama from left: Aletschhorn (4193m), Olmenhorn (3314m, middle), left of it the Mittelaletschgletscher. In the background Mönch, Trugberg (3933m), and Eiger (iceless). On the right ridge to the invisible Wannenhorn: Chamm (3866m), Fiescher Gabelhorn (3876m) and Schönbühlhorn (3854m).

places.name: Five Lakes Walk (5-Seenweg)
places.ai_summary: A picturesque hiking trail passing five beautiful mountain lakes, offering reflections of the Matterhorn and surrounding peaks.
places.place_tip: Bring water and snacks, as there are limited facilities along the trail.
